nodes.rationale: 50 mA (0.5 C) is gentle on a 100 mAh cell in a closed case.

nodes.rationale: Separate I2C bus (IO1/IO2) so an unpowered camera cannot drag the keypad bus low, including in exam mode.

nodes.label: C20 Pump Cap 4.7 uF 50 V 1206
nodes.rationale: Pump node ~20 V where 25 V X5R loses most capacitance.

nodes.label: Firmware Camera Power-Off Sequence
nodes.rationale: Avoid gpio_reset_pin() pull-ups back-powering the switched-off camera.

nodes.label: D7 SMF5.0A VBUS TVS
nodes.rationale: Hot-plugging a magnetic contact can ring above the charger's 7 V abs max.

nodes.label: R12 E-Paper Sense = 3 Ohm
nodes.rationale: B/W V4 panel reference and Waveshare HAT use 3 Ohm; 0.47 Ohm would set current limit 6x too high.

nodes.label: SCCB Pull-ups R18/R19 to CAM_2V8
nodes.rationale: Pulling to the camera's own rail avoids leaking into an unpowered camera.

nodes.label: STAT -> IO35 via Schottky D6 + R20
nodes.norm_label: stat -> io35 via schottky d6 + r20
nodes.rationale: MCP73831 STAT drives 5 V push-pull; diode lets it only pull the 3.3 V pin low.

nodes.label: USBLC6 Reference Pin on +3V3
nodes.rationale: Prevents ESP32 USB pull-up leaking onto magnet VBUS and confusing cable detect.

nodes.label: VBUS Sense Divider 10k/20k
nodes.rationale: Keeps VBUS firmly at 0 V without a cable; reads 3.17-3.5 V with a cable.

nodes.label: J1 FPC_24P DualContact CamReversed
nodes.rationale: Straight flat cable lands mirrored on standard numbering (~75% confidence); dual contact means a 180 deg twist fixes a wrong reading.

nodes.label: J3 Magnet SMD Header C42379197
nodes.rationale: SMD 5 mm header is 3.5 mm lower than THT and avoids hand-solder fee.
